title: Aquarius Weekly Horoscope September 17, 2026
youtube_description: This week brings a powerful Mercury-Neptune trine that reshapes Aquarius's worldview and love life. A career transformation is quietly unfolding in your 8th House — find out what the stars have in store. Comment your sign below for a personalized read.
script_text: The stars are about to force a reckoning for Aquarius, beginning when Mercury forms a trine with Neptune in your 9th House. The Sun crosses your 8th House in Virgo through Wednesday, intensifying finances and deep change. Wednesday is your best weekday — Venus sextiles Jupiter in your 3rd House, networking that could grow your income. Monday evening is risky: the Moon squares Uranus in your 1st House, triggering upheaval. The mid-week turning point arrives Thursday as the Sun enters Libra, igniting your 9th House. Through the weekend, Mercury's trine to Neptune flows through your 9th House, ideal for new romance and education contracts. Thursday is your power day because the Sun enters your 9th House, opening doors. Monday is your worst day — lunar tension on Uranus destabilizes your identity. As an air sign, trust logic and act on a deferred career decision; your 8th House confirms financial transformation is rolling. Follow for daily updates.
